device_description: A portable, single-patient negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT) system delivering continuous and intermittent sub-atmospheric pressure (-40 to -200 mmHg) to a sealed wound dressing via a battery-powered pump, intended for management of acute and chronic wounds.
intended_purpose: Promotion of wound healing through the application of controlled negative pressure to chronic, acute, traumatic, dehisced, and surgically closed wounds, and to skin grafts and flaps, in adult patients.
inclusion_criteria: Human clinical studies (RCT, cohort, case series with >=10 patients)
Reports clinical outcomes, performance, or safety of NPWT in target indications
exclusion_criteria: Animal or in vitro studies only
Editorials, letters, conference abstracts without data
Full text not available in English
